gloss: negative consequences shifted onto someone else; spillover burden

definitions.gloss: burden shifted onto others; ripple-effect strain
definitions.explanation: The negative side-effects of a decision, problem, or policy that end up falling on people other than those responsible. Literally "pushing wrinkles together," as when smoothing one part of cloth bunches up another.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧しわ{寄|よ}せ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: The fallout from that landed on the front-line staff.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧しわ{寄|よ}せ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{受|う}けている→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: Employees are bearing the burden of management's mistakes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大企業|だいきぎょう}→大企業：12277_daikigyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コスト→コスト：06666_kosuto⟧⟦{削減|さくげん}→削減：11789_sakugen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧しわ{寄|よ}せ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下請|したう}け→下請け：10898_shitauke⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中小企業|ちゅうしょうきぎょう}→中小企業：24117_chuushoukigyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{及|およ}んでいる→及ぶ：01921_oyobu⟧。
examples.english: The fallout from cost cuts at large corporations is reaching small subcontractor firms.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{皺|しわ}→皺：05124_shiwa⟧ (wrinkle, crease) + {寄|よ}せ (gathering, pushing together). Often written in mixed kana and kanji as しわ{寄|よ}せ. Carries a strongly negative tone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- しわ{寄|よ}せ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧: the burden falls on (someone)
- しわ{寄|よ}せ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to bear the consequences
- しわ{寄|よ}せ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{及|およ}ぶ→及ぶ：01921_oyobu⟧: the strain reaches (someone)
- しわ{寄|よ}せ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|く}う→食う：02657_kuu⟧: to get stuck with the fallout (colloquial)

USAGE:
Frequent in news and workplace contexts, especially about how policy changes or cost cuts harm those at the bottom of a hierarchy.
